device.searching: Looking for this shade over Bluetooth…
device.out_of_range: Out of Bluetooth range. Homey has not heard this shade for a while.
device.no_reading: Homey has not heard this shade broadcast its position yet, so it does not know where the other axis is. Try again in a minute.
device.needs_home_key: This shade belongs to a PowerView home and ignores commands without its home key. Add the key in the app settings.

home_key.intro: A shade that has been added to a home in the PowerView app only acts on encrypted commands. One key covers every shade in that home, so this is a one-time step. A shade that has never been added to a home works without a key.
home_key.key_hint: 32 hexadecimal characters. Spaces, colons and \x escapes are ignored, so paste it in whatever shape you have it.
home_key.gateway_hint: Hostname or IP of a PowerView Gen 3 gateway on this network. Homey asks it for the key, which takes up to half a minute while the gateway opens its own Bluetooth connections.

errors.invalid_key: That is not a 16-byte key. It should be 32 hexadecimal characters.
errors.no_gateway: Fill in the gateway's hostname or IP address first.
errors.gateway_failed: Could not read the key from the gateway: {{reason}}

settings.heading: PowerView home key
settings.intro: Shades that belong to a home in the PowerView app only act on encrypted commands. One key covers the whole home. Leave it empty if your shades have never been added to a home.
settings.key_hint: 32 hexadecimal characters. Leave empty to remove the key.
settings.poll_hint: How often Homey listens for position and battery updates, in seconds. Scanning occupies the Bluetooth radio, so shorter is not better: 60 seconds suits most homes.
settings.invalid_key: That is not a 16-byte key. It should be 32 hexadecimal characters.
